verdict.rationale: Archived docs describe Smithery Connect proxying hosted MCP servers, which would have delivered this story. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says Connect, the API, Toolbox, the CLI and the SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that Smithery remains only as a public non-proxied registry. The product therefore no longer provides hosted remote server URLs for clients to reach downstream tools.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure
